history.content: Hi, my phone has stopped connecting completely. I have no bars, no internet, and I can't send picture messages. Can you help?

I can help you troubleshoot your phone’s connectivity issues. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account. Could you please provide one of the following:

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for providing your information. Since your line is active but you have no bars, no internet, and can’t send picture messages, I’ll guide you through some troubleshooting steps.

To begin, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know what icons or messages you see at the top of your screen? This will help determine if Airplane Mode is on, if there’s a SIM issue, or if there’s another problem.
I see that Airplane Mode is on, and it says No Signal at the top of my screen. Data is enabled, and my battery is at 87%.

It looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled on your phone. When Airplane Mode is on, all wireless connections—including cellular service, mobile data, and messaging—are disabled. This is why you have no signal, no internet, and can’t send picture messages.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. Once you do, check if your signal bars return and if you can access the internet or send messages. Let me know what you see after turning Airplane Mode off, and I’ll help you with the next steps if needed.
I turned Airplane Mode off. The phone still says No Signal at the top and there are no bars. I still can't access the internet or send picture messages.

Thank you for turning off Airplane Mode. Since you still have no signal, the next step is to check your SIM card status. This will help determine if your phone is recognizing the SIM card properly.

Please check your SIM card status on your phone and let me know if it shows as:
- Active
- Missing
- Locked (PIN or PUK required)

This information will help me guide you further.
I checked the SIM card status and it says 'active.' There’s still no signal and no bars at the top of my screen.

Thank you for confirming that your SIM card status is "active." Since Airplane Mode is off and your SIM is recognized, the next step is to check your phone’s APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can prevent your phone from connecting to the network.

Please check your APN settings and let me know if they appear correct or if there’s any error or missing information, especially regarding the MMSC URL. If you’re unsure, just let me know what you see for the APN and MMSC fields.
I checked the APN settings. The APN name is 'internet,' the settings are marked as 'Correct,' and the MMSC URL is 'http://mms.carrier.com/mms.'

Thank you for checking your APN settings. Since your SIM card is active, Airplane Mode is off, and your APN settings are correct, let’s try one more step: rebooting your device. Restarting your phone can often resolve temporary network issues and help it reconnect to the cellular network.

Please restart your phone now. After it powers back on, check if you have signal bars and if you can access the internet or send picture messages. Let me know the result so I can assist you further if needed.
I restarted my phone, and it rebooted successfully, but I still have no signal bars and it still says No Signal at the top. I can't access the internet or send picture messages.
YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

arguments.summary: Customer Sofia Martinez has no cellular signal, no internet, and cannot send MMS. Airplane Mode is off, SIM status is active, APN settings are correct, and rebooting the device did not resolve the issue. Further technical investigation is required.
